messages:
lea: FYI saw a short-lived spike in provisional tokens during yesterday's canary. Suspect truncated stream + immediate reconnect.

noah: Any raw trace? toolcall or gen?

lea: Toolcall streaming. Client dropped at ~token 300, retried, router created new attempt. Both attempts show provisional tokens in billing.

ravi: We're missing an attempt-level id in billing. Router only sends session_id.

elaine: Suggest adding X-Attempt-Id and X-Resume-Offset headers on handoffs. That lets billing attach provisional credits to attempts and compute token-range unions on finalize.

hudson: Console UX: show "deduped provisional" toggle next to quota graph so SREs can compare during rollouts.

noah: Telemetry: emit billing.provisional_overlap_ratio and router.attempts_without_resume to monitor impact.

ravi: I'll update billing ingestion to accept attempt id and implement dedupe. Need a reconciliation job to backfill a day of data.

lea: Deploy-bot: canary api-canary-v13 started by hudson at 2025-07-01T11:00:00Z

deploy-bot: api-canary-v13: deployment started :rocket:

hudson: I'll take router change. lea + elaine can prototype console pill. noah add grafana panels.

elaine: Quick note: ensure attempt ids are UUID v4 and include created_at to avoid reuse collisions.

noah: Agreed. Keep the canary running but pause if provisional_overlap_ratio > 0.1 for > 5m.

lea: Thanks. Ticket #8010 tracking.
